observed_behavior: SC 3.2.3 Level AA requires navigation mechanisms repeated on multiple pages within a set to occur in the same relative order each time, except when the user initiates a change.
context: Normative WCAG 2.2 Recommendation, 12 Dec 2024; criterion level/exception preserved
limitations: Same relative order is conditional on repeated navigation; not identical appearance at all screen sizes.
notes: SC text authority only; no site accessibility testing
